title: Relata job via API: an RSS feed arrives item for item
summary: Serves a marked 3-item feed from the test harness, submits an rss -> relata job through the API, and checks COMPLETED, 3 items read, delivered equal to records, no failures, and an exact rise of DocumentChunk rows in Relata.

steps.title: Serve a small marked site from the test harness
steps.explain: Three pages of novel text (15 paragraphs each), a feed and an index, all with a unique marker, so Relata sees new documents every run.

steps.title: Count Relata chunks (Before)
steps.explain: Relata DocumentChunk row count before the run.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM DocumentChunk

steps.title: Submit the job through the API
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the run to finish
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Run finished COMPLETED
steps.explain: A clean run must report COMPLETED, not PARTIAL or FAILED.

steps.title: Delivered equals records read
steps.explain: Every record the run read must be reported as delivered to the sink.

steps.title: No record failed
steps.explain: records_failed must be 0 on a clean run.

steps.title: The run read some records
steps.explain: A run that reads nothing proves nothing.

steps.title: Run read the 3 feed items
steps.explain: Each feed item is one document.

steps.title: Count Relata chunks (After)
steps.explain: Relata DocumentChunk row count after the run.

args.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM DocumentChunk

steps.title: Relata gained exactly the delivered number of chunks
steps.explain: The run said it delivered N chunks; Relata must hold exactly N more DocumentChunk rows.

steps.title: Stop the harness site
steps.explain: Frees the port; also shows which URLs the engine fetched.
